title: Hybrid Integration of Silicon Photonic Devices on Lithium Niobate for Optomechanical Wavelength Conversion

nodes.label: Homogeneous thin-film LiNbO3 microwave-to-optical transducers lack the optomechanical coupling needed for efficient quantum transduction

requires_unseen: homogeneous LN approaches failed to reach high optomechanical coupling (linked text F3)

nodes.label: Placing a high-index Si photonic crystal cavity on a piezoelectric LiNbO3 resonator should raise optomechanical coupling while keeping piezoelectric coupling

requires_unseen: 'By incorporating a silicon cavity the optomechanical coupling ... can be significantly increased' (linked text F3)

nodes.label: Assemble the hybrid by pick-and-place with a tapered optical fibre ('slapping'), using the cavity's evanescent field as position sensor instead of tungsten tips or stamps

requires_unseen: fibre replaces tungsten tips / polymer stamps / AFM tips (linked text F2)
evanescent field as high-precision position sensor (linked text F2)

nodes.label: Suspended X-cut LN membrane 0.34x5.4x15 um with a two-finger-pair IDT (pitch 1.5 um) carrying a 250 nm Si 1D photonic crystal nanobeam

requires_unseen: dimensions, pitch and finger count (linked text F3)
attrs.design_note: few IDT fingers / small membrane chosen to keep effective mass low for optomechanical coupling at the cost of microwave coupling; simulated k_eff^2 ~1%

nodes.label: Pair X-cut LiNbO3 (large piezoelectric tensor, Lamb waves along y) with Si (high refractive index) as the optical cavity material

notes: Spine: LN coupling need -> Si-on-LN hypothesis -> slapping route + membrane/IDT architecture + LN/Si base -> lithography -> slapping (joining) -> nanobeam on membrane -> branch A: optical resonance (1588.5 nm, Q 2.86e4) -> Si confinement MEC -> g0 ~10 kHz; branch B: mechanical modes survive slapping -> joint causes into room-T transduction -> eta ~1e-7 -> conclusion. Packet figure ids are offset by one from paper figure numbers: packet F1 is an uncaptioned TOC graphic, F2 = paper Fig. 1, F3 = Fig. 2, F4 = Fig. 3, F5 = Fig. 4; linked-text 'Figure 2a' = packet F3a. F3c caption span is truncated; OCR 'IS' = 'Si'. F3b annotation 'euwy' = rotated 'Amplitude'. Placement accuracy (<100 nm) and marker Q drop rest on Figure S4, not in packet. Not in graph: S0 vs A0 piezo trade-off, LC-resonator coupling estimate (~2pi x 40 MHz), thermal anchoring claim.
